import signals = "./signals.qui"

int energy(int[] samples)
    result := 0
    for value := samples[]
        result += value * value
    return result

int isqrt(int value)
    if value == 0
        return 0
    root := value
    next := (root + 1) / 2
    while next < root
        root = next
        next = (root + value / root) / 2
    return root

int rms(int[] samples)
    return isqrt(energy(samples) / int(#samples))

int zero_crossings(int[] samples)
    result := 0
    for: 1 <= index < int(#samples)
        if (samples[index - 1] < 0) != (samples[index] < 0)
            result += 1
    return result

int count_clipped(int[] samples)
    result := 0
    for value := samples[]
        if value == -32768 or value == 32767
            result += 1
    return result

int gcd(int first, int second)
    left := first
    right := second
    while right > 0
        remainder := left % right
        left = right
        right = remainder
    return left

string crest_fraction(int[] samples)
    denominator := energy(samples)
    if denominator == 0
        return "none"
    amplitude := signals.peak(samples)
    numerator := amplitude * amplitude * int(#samples)
    divisor := gcd(numerator, denominator)
    return "{numerator / divisor}/{denominator / divisor}"

int autocorrelation(int[] samples, int lag)
    result := 0
    for: index < int(#samples) - lag
        result += samples[index] * samples[index + lag]
    return result

int pitch_lag(int[] samples, int low, int high)
    best := low
    value := autocorrelation(samples, low)
    for: low + 1 <= lag <= high
        current := autocorrelation(samples, lag)
        if current > value
            best = lag
            value = current
    return if value > 0 then best else 0

import signals = "./signals.qui"

int[] envelope(int[] samples, int attack, int release)
    level := 0
    int[] result := []
    for value := samples[]
        amplitude := signals.minimum(signals.magnitude(value), 32767)
        coefficient := if amplitude > level then attack else release
        level += signals.rdiv((amplitude - level) * coefficient, 32768)
        result = result.append(level)
    return result

class Normalized(int[] samples, int source_peak)

Normalized normalize(int[] samples, int target)
    source_peak := signals.peak(samples)
    if source_peak == 0
        return Normalized(samples, source_peak)
    int[] result := []
    for value := samples[]
        result = result.append(signals.rdiv(value * target, source_peak))
    return Normalized(result, source_peak)

class Gated(int[] samples, int muted)

Gated gate(int[] samples, int threshold, int hold)
    int[] result := []
    muted := 0
    last_loud := -1
    for: index < int(#samples)
        if signals.magnitude(samples[index]) >= threshold
            last_loud = index
        if last_loud >= 0 and index - last_loud <= hold
            result = result.append(samples[index])
        else
            result = result.append(0)
            muted += 1
    return Gated(result, muted)

class Compressed(int[] samples, int min_gain, int reduced)

Compressed compress(int[] samples, int threshold, int ratio_num, int ratio_den, int attack, int release)
    levels := envelope(samples, attack, release)
    int[] result := []
    gain := 32768
    min_gain := gain
    reduced := 0
    for: index < #samples
        level := levels[index]
        target := 32768
        if level > threshold
            limited := threshold + signals.rdiv((level - threshold) * ratio_den, ratio_num)
            target = signals.rdiv(limited * 32768, level)
        if target < gain
            gain = target
        else
            gain += signals.rdiv((target - gain) * release, 32768)
        min_gain = signals.minimum(min_gain, gain)
        if gain < 32768
            reduced += 1
        result = result.append(signals.rdiv(samples[index] * gain, 32768))
    return Compressed(result, min_gain, reduced)

import signals = "./signals.qui"

signals.Processed gain(int[] samples, int numerator, int denominator)
    clips := 0
    int[] result := []
    for value := samples[]
        result = result.append(signals.saturate(signals.rdiv(value * numerator, denominator), &clips))
    return signals.Processed(result, clips)

signals.Processed mix(int[][] tracks, int[] weights, int denominator)
    count := 0
    for track := tracks[]
        count = signals.maximum(count, int(#track))
    clips := 0
    int[] result := []
    for: index < count
        total := 0
        for: track < #tracks
            if index < int(#tracks[track])
                total += weights[track] * tracks[track][index]
        result = result.append(signals.saturate(signals.rdiv(total, denominator), &clips))
    return signals.Processed(result, clips)

int[] delay(int[] samples, int count)
    silence := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    return silence.concat(samples)

signals.Processed echo(int[] samples, int delay_length, int numerator, int denominator, int tail)
    silence := array(nat(tail), fill = 0)
    result := samples.concat(silence)
    clips := 0
    for: delay_length <= index < int(#result)
        result[index] = signals.saturate(result[index] + signals.rdiv(numerator * result[index - delay_length], denominator), &clips)
    return signals.Processed(result, clips)

int resampled_length(int length, int old_rate, int new_rate)
    return (length - 1) * new_rate / old_rate + 1

int[] resample(int[] samples, int old_rate, int new_rate)
    count := resampled_length(int(#samples), old_rate, new_rate)
    int[] result := []
    for: index < count
        position := index * old_rate / new_rate
        fraction := index * old_rate % new_rate
        value := samples[position]
        if fraction > 0
            value += signals.rdiv((samples[position + 1] - value) * fraction, new_rate)
        result = result.append(value)
    return result

int[] fade(int[] samples, int fade_in, int fade_out)
    result := samples
    count := int(#samples)
    for: index < fade_in
        result[index] = signals.rdiv(result[index] * index, fade_in)
    for: count - fade_out <= index < count
        result[index] = signals.rdiv(result[index] * (count - 1 - index), fade_out)
    return result

import signals = "./signals.qui"

signals.Processed fir(int[] samples, int divisor, int[] taps)
    int[] result := []
    clips := 0
    for: index < int(#samples)
        total := 0
        count := signals.minimum(int(#taps), index + 1)
        for: tap < count
            total += taps[tap] * samples[index - tap]
        result = result.append(signals.saturate(signals.floor_div(total, divisor), &clips))
    return signals.Processed(result, clips)

signals.Processed biquad(int[] samples, int[][] sections)
    current := samples
    clips := 0
    for section := sections[]
        int[] output := []
        previous_input := 0
        earlier_input := 0
        previous_output := 0
        earlier_output := 0
        for value := current[]
            total := section[0] * value + section[1] * previous_input + section[2] * earlier_input - section[3] * previous_output - section[4] * earlier_output
            filtered := signals.saturate(signals.floor_div(total, 16384), &clips)
            output = output.append(filtered)
            earlier_input = previous_input
            previous_input = value
            earlier_output = previous_output
            previous_output = filtered
        current = output
    return signals.Processed(current, clips)

int[] moving_average(int[] samples, int width)
    int[] result := []
    total := 0
    for: index < int(#samples)
        total += samples[index]
        if index >= width
            total -= samples[index - width]
        result = result.append(signals.rdiv(total, width))
    return result

signals.Processed dc_block(int[] samples, int numerator, int denominator)
    int[] result := []
    clips := 0
    previous_input := 0
    previous_output := 0
    for value := samples[]
        previous_output = signals.saturate(value - previous_input + signals.rdiv(numerator * previous_output, denominator), &clips)
        previous_input = value
        result = result.append(previous_output)
    return signals.Processed(result, clips)

import signals = "./signals.qui"
import effects = "./effects.qui"
import filters = "./filters.qui"
import dynamics = "./dynamics.qui"
import analysis = "./analysis.qui"

class Argument(string name, low := "", high := "")
    string kind := if name == "dst" or name == "var" then "name" elif name == "src" then "signal" elif name == "metric" then "metric" elif name == "op" then "operator" else "integer"

Argument bounded(string name, int low, int high)
    return Argument(name, string(low), string(high))

class Command(Argument[] arguments, Argument[] repeated := [], repeat_min := 0, repeat_max := 0)
    bool accepts(int count)
        extra := count - int(#arguments)
        if #repeated == 0
            return extra == 0
        width := int(#repeated)
        return extra >= 0 and extra % width == 0 and repeat_min * width <= extra <= repeat_max * width

    Argument argument_at(int index)
        if index < int(#arguments)
            return arguments[index]
        return repeated[(index - int(#arguments)) % int(#repeated)]

map<string, Command> make_commands()
    dst := Argument("dst")
    src := Argument("src")
    rate := bounded("rate", 1000, 48000)
    count := bounded("count", 1, 20000)
    numerator := bounded("num", -65536, 65536)
    denominator := bounded("den", 1, 65536)
    attack := bounded("attack", 1, 32768)
    release := bounded("release", 1, 32768)
    min_hz := Argument("min_hz", "1", "rate / 2 - 1")
    max_hz := Argument("max_hz", "min_hz + 1", "rate / 2")
    start := Argument("start", "0", "L - 1")
    test_arguments := [dst, rate, count, Argument("pos", "0", "count - 1"), bounded("amp", -32768, 32767)]
    Argument[] section := []
    for name := ["b0", "b1", "b2", "a1", "a2"][]
        section = section.append(bounded(name, -65536, 65536))
    map<string, Command> result
    .result.set("SET", Command([Argument("var"), bounded("value", -10000000, 10000000)], [Argument("op"), bounded("operand", -10000000, 10000000)], 0, 1))
    .result.set("IMPULSE", Command(test_arguments))
    .result.set("STEP", Command(test_arguments))
    .result.set("NOISE", Command([dst, rate, count, bounded("seed", 1, 2147483646)]))
    .result.set("GAIN", Command([dst, src, numerator, denominator]))
    .result.set("MIX", Command([dst, denominator], [src, bounded("weight", -65536, 65536)], 1, 8))
    .result.set("DELAY", Command([dst, src, bounded("samples", 0, 20000)]))
    .result.set("ECHO", Command([dst, src, bounded("delay", 1, 20000), numerator, denominator, bounded("tail", 0, 20000)]))
    .result.set("RESAMPLE", Command([dst, src, bounded("new_rate", 1000, 48000)]))
    .result.set("FADE", Command([dst, src, Argument("in", "0", "L"), Argument("out", "0", "L")]))
    .result.set("TRIM", Command([dst, src, start, Argument("count", "1", "L - start")]))
    .result.set("CONCAT", Command([dst], [src], 2, 8))
    .result.set("FIR", Command([dst, src, bounded("divisor", 1, 1000000)], [bounded("tap", -32768, 32767)], 1, 64))
    .result.set("BIQUAD", Command([dst, src], section, 1, 4))
    .result.set("MOVAVG", Command([dst, src, bounded("width", 1, 1000)]))
    .result.set("DCBLOCK", Command([dst, src, bounded("num", 0, 65535), Argument("den", "num + 1", "65536")]))
    .result.set("NORMALIZE", Command([dst, src, bounded("target", 1, 32767)]))
    .result.set("GATE", Command([dst, src, bounded("threshold", 1, 32768), bounded("hold", 0, 20000)]))
    .result.set("ENVELOPE", Command([dst, src, attack, release]))
    .result.set("COMPRESS", Command([dst, src, bounded("threshold", 1, 32767), bounded("ratio_num", 1, 100), Argument("ratio_den", "1", "ratio_num"), attack, release]))
    .result.set("ANALYZE", Command([src, min_hz, max_hz]))
    .result.set("COMPARE", Command([src, src]))
    .result.set("EXPECT", Command([src, Argument("metric"), Argument("op"), bounded("value", -1000000000, 1000000000)]))
    .result.set("SEGMENTS", Command([src, bounded("threshold", 1, 32768), bounded("gap", 1, 20000), bounded("min_length", 1, 20000)]))
    .result.set("ONSETS", Command([src, attack, release, bounded("threshold", 1, 32767), bounded("min_gap", 1, 20000)]))
    .result.set("PITCHTRACK", Command([src, Argument("frame", "16", "L"), Argument("hop", "1", "frame"), min_hz, max_hz, bounded("threshold", 0, 32767)]))
    .result.set("EXCERPT", Command([src, start, bounded("count", 1, 1000)]))
    .result.set("PLOT", Command([src, start, Argument("count", "1", "L - start"), Argument("columns", "8", "min(120, count)"), bounded("half", 2, 20), attack, release]))
    .result.set("METER", Command([src, bounded("block", 1, 20000)]))
    .result.set("HISTOGRAM", Command([src, bounded("bins", 2, 64)]))
    .result.set("TRACE", Command([src]))
    .result.set("SAVE", Command([src]))
    return result

bool listed(string value, string[] choices)
    for choice := choices[]
        if choice == value
            return true
    return false

bool valid_name(string token)
    int[] points := token.codepoints()
    if #points < 1 or #points > 16 or points[0] < 97 or points[0] > 122
        return false
    for: 1 <= index < #points
        point := points[index]
        if not (97 <= point <= 122 or 48 <= point <= 57 or point == 95)
            return false
    return true

bool valid_integer(string token)
    if #token == 0 or token == "-0"
        return false
    digits := if token[0] == "-" then token[1:<#token] else token
    if #digits < 1 or #digits > 10 or (#digits > 1 and digits[0] == "0")
        return false
    for point := digits.codepoints()[]
        if point < 48 or point > 57
            return false
    return true

int value_or_zero(map<string, int> values, string key)
    match values.get(key)
        int value
            return value
        none
            return 0

int milliseconds(int index, int rate)
    return index * 1000 / rate

string two_decimals(int hundredths)
    fraction := hundredths % 100
    return "{hundredths / 100}.{fraction:02.}"

string frequency_text(int rate, int lag)
    return two_decimals(signals.rdiv(100 * rate, lag))

int metric_value(string metric, int[] samples)
    if metric == "samples"
        return int(#samples)
    if metric == "peak"
        return signals.peak(samples)
    if metric == "rms"
        return analysis.rms(samples)
    if metric == "sum"
        return signals.sum_samples(samples)
    if metric == "zero_crossings"
        return analysis.zero_crossings(samples)
    return analysis.count_clipped(samples)

bool comparison(string operation, int first, int second)
    return if operation == "eq" then first == second elif operation == "ne" then first != second elif operation == "lt" then first < second elif operation == "le" then first <= second elif operation == "gt" then first > second else first >= second

class Parsed(string[] tokens)
    values := array(#tokens, fill = 0)
    int[] sources := []
    known := map<string, int>()

int set_result(Parsed arguments)
    int result := arguments.values[1]
    if #arguments.tokens == 4
        operation := arguments.tokens[2]
        int operand := arguments.values[3]
        if operation == "+"
            result += operand
        elif operation == "-"
            result -= operand
        elif operation == "*"
            result *= operand
        else
            result = signals.floor_div(result, operand)
    return result

string pad_left(string text, int width)
    result := text
    while int(#result) < width
        result = " " + result
    return result

int plot_row(int value, int scale, int rows)
    return signals.rdiv((scale - value) * (rows - 1), 2 * scale)

string[] waveform_plot(signals.Signal source, int start, int count, int columns, int half, int attack, int release)
    window := source.samples[start:<start + count]
    envelope := dynamics.envelope(source.samples, attack, release)
    levels := envelope[start:<start + count]
    rows := 2 * half + 1
    scale := signals.maximum(1, signals.peak(window))
    string[][] grid := []
    for: row < rows
        cells := array(nat(columns), fill = " ")
        grid = grid.append(cells)
    for: column < columns
        first := column * count / columns
        last := (column + 1) * count / columns
        high := window[first]
        low := high
        level := 0
        for: first <= index < last
            high = signals.maximum(high, window[index])
            low = signals.minimum(low, window[index])
            level = signals.maximum(level, levels[index])
        level = signals.minimum(scale, level)
        top := plot_row(high, scale, rows)
        bottom := plot_row(low, scale, rows)
        positive := plot_row(level, scale, rows)
        negative := plot_row(-level, scale, rows)
        for: row < rows
            grid[row][column] = if row == positive or row == negative then "*" elif top <= row <= bottom then "#" elif row == half then "-" else " "
    lines := ["PLOT {source.name} rate={source.rate} start={start} count={count} columns={columns} rows={rows} scale={scale} attack={attack} release={release}"]
    for: row < rows
        label := if row == 0 then string(scale) elif row == half then "0" elif row == rows - 1 then string(-scale) else ""
        band := grid[row].join("")
        lines = lines.append(pad_left(label, 6) + " |" + band + "|")
    axis := "       +"
    for: column < columns
        axis += if column % 10 == 0 then "+" else "-"
    lines = lines.append(axis + "+")
    timeline := "    ms"
    for: column < columns step 10
        while int(#timeline) < 8 + column
            timeline += " "
        timeline += string(milliseconds(start + column * count / columns, source.rate))
    return lines.append(timeline)

string[] meter_plot(signals.Signal source, int block)
    count := (int(#source.samples) + block - 1) / block
    lines := ["METER {source.name} rate={source.rate} samples={#source.samples} block={block} blocks={count}"]
    for: index < count
        end := signals.minimum((index + 1) * block, int(#source.samples))
        part := source.samples[index * block:<end]
        peak := signals.peak(part)
        rms := analysis.rms(part)
        peak_width := signals.rdiv(peak * 40, 32768)
        rms_width := signals.rdiv(rms * 40, 32768)
        band := ""
        for: position < 40
            band += if position < rms_width then "#" elif position < peak_width then "-" else " "
        elapsed_ms := milliseconds(index * block, source.rate)
        lines = lines.append("{elapsed_ms:6.} |{band}| peak={peak} rms={rms} clipped={analysis.count_clipped(part)}")
    return lines

string[] histogram_plot(signals.Signal source, int bins)
    counts := array(nat(bins), fill = 0)
    for value := source.samples[]
        counts[(value + 32768) * bins / 65536] += 1
    top := 0
    for count := counts[]
        top = signals.maximum(top, count)
    lines := ["HISTOGRAM {source.name} rate={source.rate} samples={#source.samples} bins={bins} max={top}"]
    for: index < bins
        lower := (index * 65536 + bins - 1) / bins - 32768
        upper := ((index + 1) * 65536 + bins - 1) / bins - 32769
        count := counts[index]
        string band := "#" * nat(signals.rdiv(count * 50, top))
        bounds := pad_left(string(lower), 6) + " " + pad_left(string(upper), 6)
        lines = lines.append("{bounds} {count:5.} |{band}")
    return lines

string pitch_row(int rate, int start, int level, int lag, int low, int high)
    elapsed_ms := milliseconds(start, rate)
    if lag == 0
        string silence := " " * 41
        return "{elapsed_ms:6.} |{silence}| unvoiced rms={level}"
    position := if high > low then signals.rdiv((high - lag) * 40, high - low) else 0
    string band := " " * nat(position) + "o" + " " * nat(40 - position)
    return "{elapsed_ms:6.} |{band}| lag={lag} hz={frequency_text(rate, lag)} rms={level}"

class Pipeline(local signals.Signal[] loaded)
    commands := make_commands()
    archive := loaded
    signal_table := map<string, int>()
    variables := map<string, int>()
    string[] log := []
    analysis_lines := ["signal,peak,rms,zero_crossings,clipped,crest,pitch_lag,pitch_hz"]
    string[] excerpts := []
    string[] waveforms := []
    string[] saved := []
    steps := 0
    errors := 0
    passed := 0
    failed := 0
    for: index < #loaded
        source := loaded[index]
        .signal_table.set(source.name, int(index))
        log = log.append("load {source.name} rate={source.rate} samples={#source.samples} peak={signals.peak(source.samples)}")

    int | error integer_value(string token)
        if token[0] == "$"
            name := token[1:<#token]
            match variables.get(name)
                int value
                    return value
                none
                    return error("undefined variable {token}")
        if not valid_integer(token)
            return error("bad integer {token}")
        return int(token)

    int resolve_bound(string bound, map<string, int> known, int first_source)
        if bound == "count - 1"
            return value_or_zero(known, "count") - 1
        if bound == "min(120, count)"
            return signals.minimum(120, value_or_zero(known, "count"))
        if bound == "min_hz + 1"
            return value_or_zero(known, "min_hz") + 1
        if bound == "num + 1"
            return value_or_zero(known, "num") + 1
        if bound == "ratio_num" or bound == "frame"
            return value_or_zero(known, bound)
        if bound == "L" or bound == "L - 1" or bound == "L - start"
            length := int(#archive[first_source].samples)
            if bound == "L"
                return length
            if bound == "L - 1"
                return length - 1
            return length - value_or_zero(known, "start")
        if bound == "rate / 2" or bound == "rate / 2 - 1"
            int rate := archive[first_source].rate
            return if bound == "rate / 2" then rate / 2 else rate / 2 - 1
        return int(bound)

    Parsed | error parse_arguments(string name, Command command, string[] tokens)
        result := Parsed(tokens)
        for: index < #tokens
            token := tokens[index]
            argument := command.argument_at(int(index))
            if argument.kind == "name"
                if not valid_name(token)
                    return error("bad name {token}")
            elif argument.kind == "signal"
                match signal_table.get(token)
                    int version
                        result.sources = result.sources.append(version)
                    none
                        return error("unknown signal {token}")
            elif argument.kind == "metric"
                if not listed(token, ["samples", "peak", "rms", "sum", "zero_crossings", "clipped"])
                    return error("unknown metric {token}")
            elif argument.kind == "operator"
                string[] allowed := if name == "SET" then ["+", "-", "*", "/"] else ["eq", "ne", "lt", "le", "gt", "ge"]
                if not listed(token, allowed)
                    return error("unknown operator {token}")
            else
                int value := try integer_value(token)
                first_source := if #result.sources > 0 then result.sources[0] else -1
                int low := resolve_bound(argument.low, result.known, first_source)
                int high := resolve_bound(argument.high, result.known, first_source)
                if value < low or value > high
                    return error("{argument.name} out of range")
                result.values[index] = value
                .result.known.set(argument.name, value)
        return result

    string check_command(string name, Parsed arguments)
        int[] values := arguments.values
        if name == "SET"
            if #arguments.tokens == 4
                if arguments.tokens[2] == "/" and values[3] == 0
                    return "division by zero"
                if signals.magnitude(set_result(arguments)) > 10000000
                    return "value out of range"
            return ""
        if #arguments.sources == 0
            return ""
        signals.Signal source := archive[arguments.sources[0]]
        length := int(#source.samples)
        if name == "MIX" or name == "CONCAT" or name == "COMPARE"
            combined_length := 0
            for version := arguments.sources[]
                signals.Signal ingredient := archive[version]
                if ingredient.rate != source.rate
                    return "rate mismatch"
                combined_length += int(#ingredient.samples)
            if name == "CONCAT" and combined_length > 20000
                return "result too long"
        elif name == "DELAY"
            if length + values[2] > 20000
                return "result too long"
        elif name == "ECHO"
            if signals.magnitude(values[3]) >= values[4]
                return "unstable feedback"
            if length + values[5] > 20000
                return "result too long"
        elif name == "RESAMPLE"
            if effects.resampled_length(length, source.rate, values[2]) > 20000
                return "result too long"
        elif name == "ANALYZE" or name == "PITCHTRACK"
            min_hz := if name == "ANALYZE" then values[1] else values[3]
            max_hz := if name == "ANALYZE" then values[2] else values[4]
            low := (source.rate + max_hz - 1) / max_hz
            high := source.rate / min_hz
            if low > high
                return "empty lag range"
            if name == "ANALYZE" and high >= length
                return "signal too short"
            if name == "PITCHTRACK" and high >= values[1]
                return "frame too short"
        return ""

    string .register_signal(int number, string command, Parsed arguments, int rate, int[] samples, string extras)
        name := arguments.tokens[0]
        version := int(#archive)
        archive = archive.append(signals.Signal(name, rate, samples, "line {number} {command}", arguments.sources))
        .signal_table.set(name, version)
        return "{name} rate={rate} samples={#samples} peak={signals.peak(samples)} sum={signals.sum_samples(samples)}{extras}"

    string .generate(int number, string command, Parsed arguments)
        int[] values := arguments.values
        if command == "IMPULSE" or command == "STEP"
            samples := if command == "IMPULSE" then signals.impulse(values[2], values[3], values[4]) else signals.step(values[2], values[3], values[4])
            return .register_signal(number, command, arguments, values[1], samples, "")
        if command == "NOISE"
            return .register_signal(number, command, arguments, values[1], signals.noise(values[2], values[3]), "")
        signals.Signal source := archive[arguments.sources[0]]
        rate := source.rate
        int[] samples := []
        extras := ""
        if command == "GAIN"
            result := effects.gain(source.samples, values[2], values[3])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "MIX"
            int[][] tracks := []
            int[] weights := []
            for: index < #arguments.sources
                tracks = tracks.append(archive[arguments.sources[index]].samples)
                weights = weights.append(values[3 + int(index) * 2])
            result := effects.mix(tracks, weights, values[1])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "DELAY"
            samples = effects.delay(source.samples, values[2])
        elif command == "ECHO"
            result := effects.echo(source.samples, values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "RESAMPLE"
            rate = values[2]
            samples = effects.resample(source.samples, source.rate, rate)
        elif command == "FADE"
            samples = effects.fade(source.samples, values[2], values[3])
        elif command == "TRIM"
            samples = source.samples[values[2]:<values[2] + values[3]]
        elif command == "CONCAT"
            for version := arguments.sources[]
                samples = samples.concat(archive[version].samples)
        elif command == "FIR"
            result := filters.fir(source.samples, values[2], values[3:<#values])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "BIQUAD"
            int[][] sections := []
            for: 2 <= start < int(#values) step 5
                sections = sections.append(values[start:<start + 5])
            result := filters.biquad(source.samples, sections)
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " sections={#sections} clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "MOVAVG"
            samples = filters.moving_average(source.samples, values[2])
        elif command == "DCBLOCK"
            result := filters.dc_block(source.samples, values[2], values[3])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " clipped={result.clipped}"
        elif command == "NORMALIZE"
            result := dynamics.normalize(source.samples, values[2])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " source_peak={result.source_peak}"
        elif command == "GATE"
            result := dynamics.gate(source.samples, values[2], values[3])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " muted={result.muted}"
        elif command == "ENVELOPE"
            samples = dynamics.envelope(source.samples, values[2], values[3])
        elif command == "COMPRESS"
            result := dynamics.compress(source.samples, values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5], values[6])
            samples = result.samples
            extras = " min_gain={result.min_gain} reduced={result.reduced}"
        return .register_signal(number, command, arguments, rate, samples, extras)

    void trace_lines(int version, int depth, string[] &lines)
        signals.Signal source := archive[version]
        string indent := " " * nat(2 * depth)
        lines = lines.append("{indent}{source.name} <- {source.origin}")
        for ingredient := source.ingredients[]
            trace_lines(ingredient, depth + 1, &lines)

    string compare_signals(signals.Signal first, signals.Signal second)
        count := signals.maximum(int(#first.samples), int(#second.samples))
        differing := 0
        max_diff := 0
        first_index := "none"
        error_energy := 0
        for: index < count
            left := if index < int(#first.samples) then first.samples[index] else 0
            right := if index < int(#second.samples) then second.samples[index] else 0
            difference := left - right
            if difference != 0
                if differing == 0
                    first_index = string(index)
                differing += 1
            max_diff = signals.maximum(max_diff, signals.magnitude(difference))
            error_energy += difference * difference
        return "{first.name} {second.name} differing={differing} max_diff={max_diff} first={first_index} error_energy={error_energy}"

    string[] segment_lines(signals.Signal source, int threshold, int gap, int min_length)
        int[][] found := []
        for: index < int(#source.samples)
            if signals.magnitude(source.samples[index]) >= threshold
                last := int(#found) - 1
                if last >= 0 and index - found[last][1] <= gap
                    found[last][1] = index
                else
                    found = found.append([index, index])
        string[] details := []
        for segment := found[]
            start := segment[0]
            end := segment[1]
            if end - start + 1 >= min_length
                part := source.samples[start:<end + 1]
                number := int(#details) + 1
                details = details.append("  segment {number} start={start} end={end} start_ms={milliseconds(start, source.rate)} end_ms={milliseconds(end, source.rate)} peak={signals.peak(part)} rms={analysis.rms(part)} crossings={analysis.zero_crossings(part)}")
        heading := ["{source.name} segments={#details}"]
        return heading.concat(details)

    string[] onset_lines(signals.Signal source, int attack, int release, int threshold, int min_gap)
        levels := dynamics.envelope(source.samples, attack, release)
        int[] found := []
        int[] intervals := []
        for: index < int(#levels)
            rising := levels[index] >= threshold and (index == 0 or levels[index - 1] < threshold)
            if rising and (#found == 0 or index - found[-1] >= min_gap)
                if #found > 0
                    intervals = intervals.append(index - found[-1])
                found = found.append(index)
        tempo := "none"
        if #found >= 2
            ordered := intervals.sorted()
            middle := ordered[(#found - 2) / 2]
            tempo = two_decimals(signals.rdiv(6000 * source.rate, middle))
        lines := ["{source.name} onsets={#found} tempo={tempo}"]
        for: index < #found
            sample := found[index]
            interval := if index == 0 then "none" else string(intervals[index - 1])
            lines = lines.append("  onset {index + 1} sample={sample} ms={milliseconds(sample, source.rate)} interval={interval}")
        return lines

    string .analyze_signal(signals.Signal source, int min_hz, int max_hz)
        low := (source.rate + max_hz - 1) / max_hz
        high := source.rate / min_hz
        lag := analysis.pitch_lag(source.samples, low, high)
        lag_text := if lag == 0 then "none" else string(lag)
        hz_text := if lag == 0 then "none" else frequency_text(source.rate, lag)
        analysis_lines = analysis_lines.append("{source.name},{signals.peak(source.samples)},{analysis.rms(source.samples)},{analysis.zero_crossings(source.samples)},{analysis.count_clipped(source.samples)},{analysis.crest_fraction(source.samples)},{lag_text},{hz_text}")
        return "{source.name} lags={low}-{high}"

    string .pitch_track(signals.Signal source, int frame, int hop, int min_hz, int max_hz, int threshold)
        low := (source.rate + max_hz - 1) / max_hz
        high := source.rate / min_hz
        count := (int(#source.samples) - frame) / hop + 1
        voiced := 0
        string[] rows := []
        for: index < count
            start := index * hop
            window := source.samples[start:<start + frame]
            level := analysis.rms(window)
            lag := if level < threshold then 0 else analysis.pitch_lag(window, low, high)
            if lag > 0
                voiced += 1
            rows = rows.append(pitch_row(source.rate, start, level, lag, low, high))
        waveforms = waveforms.append("PITCHTRACK {source.name} rate={source.rate} frame={frame} hop={hop} lags={low}-{high} threshold={threshold} frames={count} voiced={voiced}")
        waveforms = waveforms.concat(rows)
        return "{source.name} frames={count} voiced={voiced}"

    string .excerpt_signal(signals.Signal source, int start, int count)
        length := signals.minimum(count, int(#source.samples) - start)
        excerpts = excerpts.append("EXCERPT {source.name} rate={source.rate} samples={#source.samples} start={start} count={length}")
        for: offset < length step 8
            end := signals.minimum(length, offset + 8)
            first := start + offset
            line := "{first:5.}:"
            for: offset <= index < end
                value := source.samples[start + index]
                line += " " + pad_left(string(value), 6)
            excerpts = excerpts.append(line)
        return "{source.name} start={start} count={length}"

    string[] | error .execute(int number, string name, string[] tokens)
        Command command
        match commands.get(name)
            Command found
                command = found
            none
                return error("unknown command {name}")
        if not command.accepts(int(#tokens))
            return error("wrong number of arguments")
        Parsed arguments := try parse_arguments(name, command, tokens)
        string failure := check_command(name, arguments)
        if failure != ""
            return error(failure)
        if name == "SET"
            result := set_result(arguments)
            .variables.set(tokens[0], result)
            return ["{tokens[0]}={result}"]
        if listed(name, ["IMPULSE", "STEP", "NOISE", "GAIN", "MIX", "DELAY", "ECHO", "RESAMPLE", "FADE", "TRIM", "CONCAT", "FIR", "BIQUAD", "MOVAVG", "DCBLOCK", "NORMALIZE", "GATE", "ENVELOPE", "COMPRESS"])
            return [.generate(number, name, arguments)]
        signals.Signal source := archive[arguments.sources[0]]
        int[] values := arguments.values
        if name == "ANALYZE"
            return [.analyze_signal(source, values[1], values[2])]
        if name == "COMPARE"
            return [compare_signals(source, archive[arguments.sources[1]])]
        if name == "EXPECT"
            measured := metric_value(tokens[1], source.samples)
            satisfied := comparison(tokens[2], measured, values[3])
            if satisfied
                passed += 1
            else
                failed += 1
            outcome := if satisfied then "pass" else "fail"
            return ["{source.name} {tokens[1]}={measured} {tokens[2]} {values[3]} {outcome}"]
        if name == "SEGMENTS"
            return segment_lines(source, values[1], values[2], values[3])
        if name == "ONSETS"
            return onset_lines(source, values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4])
        if name == "PITCHTRACK"
            return [.pitch_track(source, values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5])]
        if name == "EXCERPT"
            return [.excerpt_signal(source, values[1], values[2])]
        if name == "PLOT"
            waveforms = waveforms.concat(waveform_plot(source, values[1], values[2], values[3], values[4], values[5], values[6]))
            return ["{source.name} start={values[1]} count={values[2]} columns={values[3]} rows={2 * values[4] + 1}"]
        if name == "METER"
            waveforms = waveforms.concat(meter_plot(source, values[1]))
            return ["{source.name} block={values[1]}"]
        if name == "HISTOGRAM"
            waveforms = waveforms.concat(histogram_plot(source, values[1]))
            return ["{source.name} bins={values[1]}"]
        if name == "TRACE"
            lines := [source.name]
            trace_lines(arguments.sources[0], 1, &lines)
            return lines
        saved = saved.concat(signals.format_signal(source))
        return ["{source.name} samples={#source.samples}"]

    void .run_line(int number, string line)
        tokens := line.split(" ")
        name := tokens[0]
        match .execute(number, name, tokens[1:<#tokens])
            string[] details
                log = log.append("line {number}: {name} {details[0]}")
                log = log.concat(details[1:<#details])
                steps += 1
            error problem
                log = log.append("line {number}: error: {problem.message}")
                errors += 1

    void .run()
        string text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/pipeline.txt"))
        lines := text.split(NL)
        for: index < #lines
            if lines[index] != "" and lines[index][0] != "#"
                .run_line(int(index) + 1, lines[index])
        for name := signal_table.keys().sorted()[]
            signals.Signal source := archive[value_or_zero(signal_table, name)]
            log = log.append("signal {name} rate={source.rate} samples={#source.samples} peak={signals.peak(source.samples)} rms={analysis.rms(source.samples)}")
        log = log.append("summary steps={steps} errors={errors} signals={signal_table.size()} passed={passed} failed={failed}")

void write_lines(string name, string[] lines)
    string text := if #lines == 0 then "" else lines.join(NL) + NL
    writer1 := file.write("output/" + name)
    .writer1(text)

if main
    pipeline := Pipeline(signals.read_signals())
    .pipeline.run()

int magnitude(int value)
    return if value < 0 then -value else value

int minimum(int first, int second)
    return if first < second then first else second

int maximum(int first, int second)
    return if first > second then first else second

int floor_div(int numerator, int denominator)
    upper := numerator
    lower := denominator
    if lower < 0
        upper = -upper
        lower = -lower
    if upper >= 0
        return upper / lower
    return -((-upper + lower - 1) / lower)

int rdiv(int numerator, int denominator)
    return floor_div(2 * numerator + denominator, 2 * denominator)

int saturate(int value, int &clips)
    limited := maximum(-32768, minimum(32767, value))
    if limited != value
        clips += 1
    return limited

int peak(int[] samples)
    result := 0
    for value := samples[]
        result = maximum(result, magnitude(value))
    return result

int sum_samples(int[] samples)
    result := 0
    for value := samples[]
        result += value
    return result

class Signal(string name, int rate, int[] samples, origin := "input", int[] ingredients := [])

class Processed(int[] samples, int clipped)

Signal[] read_signals()
    text := string.from_utf8(file.read_bin("input/signals.txt"))
    lines := text.split(NL)
    Signal[] result := []
    index := 0
    while index < int(#lines) and lines[index] != ""
        header := lines[index].split(" ")
        count := int(header[3])
        index += 1
        int[] samples := []
        while int(#samples) < count
            for token := lines[index].split(" ")[]
                samples = samples.append(int(token))
            index += 1
        result = result.append(Signal(header[1], int(header[2]), samples))
    return result

string[] format_signal(Signal signal)
    lines := ["SIGNAL {signal.name} {signal.rate} {#signal.samples}"]
    for: start < int(#signal.samples) step 16
        end := minimum(start + 16, int(#signal.samples))
        string[] values := []
        for: start <= index < end
            values = values.append(string(signal.samples[index]))
        lines = lines.append(values.join(" "))
    return lines

int[] impulse(int count, int position, int amplitude)
    result := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    result[position] = amplitude
    return result

int[] step(int count, int position, int amplitude)
    result := array(nat(count), fill = 0)
    for: position <= index < count
        result[index] = amplitude
    return result

int[] noise(int count, int seed)
    state := seed
    int[] result := []
    for: index < count
        state = (48271 * state) % 2147483647
        result = result.append(state % 65536 - 32768)
    return result
